rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and ZIP to a unique account before sharing order details. It correctly identified the order with the Bluetooth speaker, provided accurate price and battery-life information from tools, and proposed a compliant path (exchange/modify) instead of canceling a single item. The agent listed available under-$300 options and, after the user chose one, explicitly asked for confirmation before making any changes. It then performed the modification via tools, reflecting the correct replacement and refund, and reported the updated order status accurately. Finally, it confirmed the new total ($1,288.65), which matches the item prices and refund shown in the tool results. Minor nitpicks: the agent stated single-item cancellation wasn’t possible without explicit tool evidence and omitted one qualifying option in the under-$300 list, but these did not affect correctness or policy adherence. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
